governance.nextPermittedJob: W011 (Remediation separately gated by CTO authorization)

capabilities.name: User Profile Database Table & Fields
capabilities.currentBehavior: Stores user_id (PK refs auth.users), display_name (2-50), bio (<=300), avatar_url, constituency_id, state_code, role, reputation_score, post_count, is_suspended, verification_status.
capabilities.rlsStatus: FORCE RLS active (038). Public SELECT where is_suspended = false. INSERT/UPDATE restricted to auth.uid() = user_id.
capabilities.mediaStorageDependency: avatar_url is raw text string; no bucket configured.
capabilities.knownDefects: fetchVerifiedPoliticians in supabaseDataService.ts:1400 queries non-existent columns (id, constituency, state) instead of (user_id, constituency_id, state_code).
capabilities.reusableComponents: Base schema, role check constraint, verification status flag.
capabilities.whatMustBeBuiltLater: Columns for cover_image_url, handle/username (unique), privacy_level, contact preferences, social links, follower_count, following_count.

capabilities.name: Avatar / Profile Photo Support
capabilities.currentBehavior: Renders avatarImage if avatarUrl is present, falls back to person icon. updateUserProfile accepts avatarUrl string.
capabilities.mediaStorageDependency: Requires external URL or pre-existing image; no upload mechanism in profile editor.
capabilities.knownDefects: EditProfileScreen (apps/mobile/app/edit-profile.tsx) omits avatar selection/upload UI entirely.
capabilities.reusableComponents: UserProfileCard avatar rendering with role-colored border.
capabilities.whatMustBeBuiltLater: Avatar picker integration with Supabase Storage avatars bucket and image cropping/resizing.

capabilities.name: Cover / Banner Support
capabilities.classification: EXISTS — NOT SUITABLE FOR FUTURE REQUIREMENT
capabilities.currentBehavior: Only organizational / leader pages have banner_url. Regular citizen user_profiles table has no banner column.
capabilities.knownDefects: Citizen profiles cannot have a banner/cover photo.
capabilities.whatMustBeBuiltLater: Migration adding banner_url to user_profiles; banner display and upload component on Profile screen.

capabilities.name: Username / Unique Handle
capabilities.fileOrTable: user_profiles table (lacks handle column; only pages table has handle)
capabilities.currentBehavior: Users only have non-unique display_name (2-50 chars).
capabilities.persistenceTarget: None for users (pages table has handle TEXT UNIQUE)
capabilities.knownDefects: Cannot tag or @-mention users; no unique human-readable URL route (e.g. /@username).
capabilities.reusableComponents: Handle validation logic from pages table (char_length between 2 and 50).
capabilities.whatMustBeBuiltLater: Migration adding handle TEXT UNIQUE to user_profiles; handle validation regex and claim endpoint.

capabilities.name: Bio / About Description
capabilities.currentBehavior: Bio field up to 300 chars persisted to user_profiles via updateMyProfile.
capabilities.knownDefects: None
capabilities.whatMustBeBuiltLater: Support for markdown formatting, hashtags, and mentions in bio.

capabilities.name: Location / Kshetra Association
capabilities.currentBehavior: Stores home constituency in mobile MMKV; writes constituency_id to user_profiles if passed during onboarding.
capabilities.knownDefects: Onboarding generates synthetic user ID (user-${Date.now()}) in local store; home constituency is stored in client MMKV and rarely synchronized with user_profiles.
capabilities.whatMustBeBuiltLater: Strict bidirectional sync between myConstituency store and user_profiles.constituency_id.

capabilities.name: Privacy Controls
capabilities.currentBehavior: No privacy settings column. All non-suspended user profiles are 100% public (Public read user_profiles policy).
capabilities.knownDefects: Users have zero control over profile visibility, DM permissions, or location disclosure.
capabilities.whatMustBeBuiltLater: privacy_settings JSONB column (is_private, allow_dms, show_activity, show_constituency).

capabilities.name: Profile API Routes
capabilities.currentBehavior: No Fastify API route exists for user profile management. All mutations bypass API directly to Supabase.
capabilities.knownDefects: Bypasses Fastify apiClient strangler architecture.
capabilities.whatMustBeBuiltLater: Fastify routes: GET /api/v1/profile/me, PATCH /api/v1/profile/me, GET /api/v1/profile/:handleOrId.

capabilities.name: Profile Screens (Mobile)
capabilities.currentBehavior: Profile tab is settings-oriented; EditProfile allows editing display name and bio; UserProfileScreen renders external user profile and post list.
capabilities.knownDefects: Profile tab lacks social activity feed, badges showcase, media gallery, or status strip.
capabilities.whatMustBeBuiltLater: Redesigned Profile 2.0 screen featuring cover photo, status ring around avatar, tabs (Posts, Replies, Upvotes, Media, About).

capabilities.name: Image Upload & Storage Pipeline
capabilities.currentBehavior: Image picker returns local file:// URI which is stored directly in state. No cloud storage upload occurs.
capabilities.knownDefects: Local file URIs cannot be viewed by other devices or users.
capabilities.whatMustBeBuiltLater: Supabase Storage bucket provisioning ('profiles', 'posts', 'statuses'), pre-signed upload URL API, upload service in mobile.

capabilities.name: Image Transformation & Compression
capabilities.currentBehavior: Raw camera captures at quality 0.7 from ImagePicker without dimension resizing, WebP conversion, or CDN optimization.
capabilities.knownDefects: Full-resolution uncompressed images waste user bandwidth and device storage.
capabilities.whatMustBeBuiltLater: Client-side image manipulation (expo-image-manipulator) and Supabase/Cloudflare image transformation.

capabilities.name: Profile Moderation & Security Controls
capabilities.currentBehavior: Fastify provides moderation endpoints; user_profiles has is_suspended, suspended_until, suspension_reason with RLS hiding suspended profiles.
capabilities.rlsStatus: Public read user_profiles hides suspended users.
capabilities.knownDefects: DisplayName and bio edits in EditProfileScreen do not run through checkContentModeration before updating.
capabilities.whatMustBeBuiltLater: Automated text moderation on profile update; avatar image moderation.

capabilities.name: Posts (Discussions, News, Opinions, Alerts)
capabilities.currentBehavior: Full CRUD for posts with type, state_code, constituency_id, language, reply_count, reaction_count, soft deletion (is_deleted), and Realtime replication.
capabilities.rlsStatus: FORCE RLS active. Public SELECT is_deleted = false. INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE enforced on author_id.
capabilities.notificationDependency: notification_log trigger types post_reply, comment_reply exist.
capabilities.knownDefects: W011-DEF-01: ComposeSheet generates synthetic local-* ID and never reconciles with server UUID. W011-DEF-07: feed.ts duplicates submissions.
capabilities.reusableComponents: PostCard component, state_feed SQL view, Realtime subscription.
capabilities.whatMustBeBuiltLater: Reconcile synthetic IDs on post creation; migrate direct Supabase queries to Fastify API.

capabilities.name: Comments & Replies
capabilities.currentBehavior: Single-level comments with content moderation check before insert; reaction_count and language tracking; Realtime enabled.
capabilities.rlsStatus: Public read is_deleted = false. Authors update/delete.
capabilities.notificationDependency: Trigger type comment_reply exists in schema.
capabilities.knownDefects: W011-DEF-02: PostDetailModal generates synthetic local-c-* ID un-reconciled. W011-DEF-06: offlineSync drops add_comment operations.
capabilities.whatMustBeBuiltLater: Nested reply threading (parent_id on comments); fix offline queue drop; reconcile comment IDs.

capabilities.name: Reactions / Likes
capabilities.currentBehavior: Allows 4 reaction types ('like', 'insightful', 'disagree', 'celebrate') on posts or comments; enforces 1 reaction per user per target via unique index.
capabilities.notificationDependency: Trigger type reaction exists in schema.
capabilities.knownDefects: None in database logic; optimistic reaction toggle in feed.ts does not track 4-state sync lifecycle (W011-DEF-08).
capabilities.reusableComponents: REACTION_CONFIG and reaction picker sheet in PostCard.
capabilities.whatMustBeBuiltLater: Reaction counters trigger function to auto-update post.reaction_count atomically in database.

capabilities.name: Shares / Reposts
capabilities.classification: EXISTS — NOT SUITABLE FOR FUTURE REQUIREMENT
capabilities.currentBehavior: Invokes native OS share dialog with post text and fallback URL.
capabilities.knownDefects: No in-app repost / quote-post functionality; no share tracking or share counters.
capabilities.whatMustBeBuiltLater: In-app repost model (posts.parent_id or dedicated shares table), share counter on posts, share notification.

capabilities.name: Saves / Bookmarks
capabilities.currentBehavior: No saved posts or bookmarks table exists in database or mobile stores.
capabilities.knownDefects: Citizens cannot bookmark important civic posts, notices, or news.
capabilities.whatMustBeBuiltLater: Migration creating post_bookmarks (id, user_id, post_id, created_at); Bookmark action in PostCard; Saved Posts tab in Profile.

capabilities.name: Polls & Voting
capabilities.currentBehavior: Schema supports polls with options and unique user votes. However, composePost does not insert into polls or poll_options tables.
capabilities.knownDefects: ComposeSheet generates local synthetic IDs (poll-local-*, opt-local-*) and does not save poll to database. Poll creation is non-functional on server.
capabilities.reusableComponents: votePoll function in supabaseDataService.ts:352; poll rendering UI in PostCard.
capabilities.whatMustBeBuiltLater: Server-side transaction creating post + poll + options atomically; expiry scheduler.

capabilities.name: Media Attachments
capabilities.classification: EXISTS — NOT SUITABLE FOR FUTURE REQUIREMENT
capabilities.currentBehavior: Table exists in PostgreSQL with media_type ('image', 'link', 'video'), url, thumbnail_url, alt_text. But neither DataService nor UI ever reads or writes to it.
capabilities.knownDefects: Complete disconnect between database table and application code.
capabilities.whatMustBeBuiltLater: Wire post_media to composePost and PostCard rendering; connect to cloud storage upload.

capabilities.name: Shorts (Vertical Video)
capabilities.currentBehavior: Database table exists for video_url, channel_name, approvals, flags. But mobile store writes strictly to MMKV with synthetic IDs (short-user-*).
capabilities.knownDefects: Citizen shorts uploads are trapped on local device (W011-DEF-04).
capabilities.whatMustBeBuiltLater: Wire politicalShorts store to backend API/Supabase; video transcoding and HLS streaming pipeline.

capabilities.name: Drafts
capabilities.currentBehavior: ComposeSheet discards unsaved text on modal dismiss. No draft saving exists for feed posts.
capabilities.knownDefects: Accidental dismiss causes immediate content loss.
capabilities.whatMustBeBuiltLater: Local MMKV auto-save draft mechanism in ComposeSheet with restore prompt.

capabilities.name: Feed Ranking & Algorithmic Sorting
capabilities.currentBehavior: Strictly chronological ordering (ORDER BY created_at DESC). Feed tabs ('foryou', 'latest', 'constituency', 'following') filter by author or scope client-side.
capabilities.knownDefects: 'foryou' tab is identical to 'latest' with minor local shuffle; no algorithmic engagement scoring or decay function.
capabilities.whatMustBeBuiltLater: Server-side engagement score calculation (upvotes * 2 + comments * 3 - time_decay) or materialized trending view.

capabilities.name: Feed Pagination & Local Caching
capabilities.currentBehavior: Page-based cursor pagination (limit 20), cached in AsyncStorage ('kshetra-feed'), with pull-to-refresh and offline fallback.
capabilities.geographyDependency: Preserves active state and constituency filters.
capabilities.knownDefects: feed.ts stores posts with synthetic local-* IDs permanently if offline (W011-DEF-01).
capabilities.reusableComponents: Pagination logic and pull-to-refresh state machine.
capabilities.whatMustBeBuiltLater: Reconcile optimistic posts upon network reconnect; integrate 4-state sync lifecycle (W011-DEF-08).

capabilities.name: User-to-User Follows
capabilities.currentBehavior: Upserts into user_follows (follower_id, followed_id) with unique constraint. fetchFollowedUserIds loads list of followed IDs.
capabilities.rlsStatus: FORCE RLS active. Public read user_follows. INSERT/DELETE restricted to auth.uid() = follower_id.
capabilities.notificationDependency: Missing 'new_follower' trigger in notification_log CHECK constraint.
capabilities.knownDefects: No follow counter columns on user_profiles (requires runtime count(*) queries); no follow notification dispatched.
capabilities.reusableComponents: user_follows schema and indexes; DataService follow methods.
capabilities.whatMustBeBuiltLater: Follower/following count triggers on user_profiles; notification dispatch on follow.

capabilities.name: Geography Follows (Constituency / Ward / Mandal)
capabilities.currentBehavior: user_favourites table exists in DB with RLS, but mobile client uses local AsyncStorage store and NEVER reads/writes user_favourites in Supabase.
capabilities.notificationDependency: Constituency alert notifications cannot target database followers.
capabilities.knownDefects: Constituency favorites are lost on app uninstall or device switch; server cannot push constituency alerts to followers.
capabilities.whatMustBeBuiltLater: Wire useFavoritesStore to sync with user_favourites table; extend to follow mandals and wards.

capabilities.name: Topic / Entity Follows (Issues & Promises)
capabilities.currentBehavior: Users can follow civic issues and election promises to receive milestone notifications.
capabilities.apiPath: issue_follows uses apiClient (Fastify); promise_follows is direct Supabase or local store
capabilities.knownDefects: W011-DEF-03: toggleFollowPromise in stores/promises.ts mutates local state only without calling DataService.
capabilities.whatMustBeBuiltLater: Wire promise follows to database; add hashtag/topic follow capability.

capabilities.name: Follower & Following Views (Mobile)
capabilities.currentBehavior: Clicking followers count or following count does nothing. No screen or modal exists to view lists of followers or following.
capabilities.knownDefects: Social graph is opaque to users; cannot see who follows a user or who a user follows.
capabilities.whatMustBeBuiltLater: Screen /user/[userId]/connections.tsx with tabs for 'Followers' and 'Following', search bar, and Follow/Unfollow buttons.

capabilities.name: Follow Notifications
capabilities.currentBehavior: notification_log trigger_type CHECK constraint omits 'user_follow' / 'new_follower'.
capabilities.knownDefects: Users are never notified when someone follows them.
capabilities.whatMustBeBuiltLater: Migration adding 'new_follower' to notification_log and notification_preferences CHECK constraints; trigger on user_follows insert.

capabilities.name: 24-Hour Ephemeral Status / Stories
capabilities.currentBehavior: Zero implementation in database, API, or mobile client. No concept of ephemeral 24-hour stories exists.
capabilities.knownDefects: Feature completely absent.
capabilities.whatMustBeBuiltLater: Table user_statuses (id, user_id, media_url, media_type, caption, expires_at, view_count, created_at) with 24h default TTL.

capabilities.name: Status Media Pipeline
capabilities.currentBehavior: No storage or processing pipeline for status images/videos.
capabilities.knownDefects: None
capabilities.whatMustBeBuiltLater: Supabase Storage bucket with public read and authenticated insert; client compression.

capabilities.name: Status Viewer UI Component
capabilities.currentBehavior: No fullscreen story/status viewer with timer progress bars, swipe gestures, or reply actions.
capabilities.knownDefects: None
capabilities.whatMustBeBuiltLater: StatusViewerModal with animated top progress segments, tap left/right to navigate, swipe down to dismiss, reply box.

capabilities.name: Expiry & TTL Infrastructure
capabilities.currentBehavior: No pg_cron, pg_partman, or background worker exists in migrations to purge expired rows or media.
capabilities.knownDefects: Expired data would accumulate indefinitely without automated cleanup.
capabilities.reusableComponents: expires_at timestamp pattern from polls table.
capabilities.whatMustBeBuiltLater: Supabase pg_cron job or scheduled Edge function running hourly: DELETE FROM user_statuses WHERE expires_at < now().

capabilities.name: Realtime Presence / Online Indicator
capabilities.currentBehavior: Realtime service subscribes to table changes (posts, comments, reactions), but does not use Supabase Realtime Presence channels.
capabilities.knownDefects: Users have no indication whether representatives or peers are active.
capabilities.whatMustBeBuiltLater: channel.track({ online_at: new Date().toISOString() }) on user profile channels.

capabilities.name: Notification Database Tables (Log & Preferences)
capabilities.currentBehavior: Complete schema with RLS, delivery tracking (delivered_at, read_at), JSONB data payloads, source references, and per-trigger preferences.
capabilities.rlsStatus: FORCE RLS active. Users read/update own log and preferences.
capabilities.knownDefects: trigger_type CHECK constraint lacks 'new_follower', 'mention', 'status_reply'.
capabilities.whatMustBeBuiltLater: Migration expanding trigger_type CHECK constraint.

capabilities.name: Notification Triggers (Mobile)
capabilities.currentBehavior: Fires local notifications and populates local store for civic issues, promise updates, delimitation, and elections. Checks categories enabled.
capabilities.knownDefects: No triggers exist for social engagement (no follow, reply, reaction, mention, or DM triggers in notificationTriggers.ts).
capabilities.whatMustBeBuiltLater: Social engagement triggers: notifyNewFollower, notifyPostReply, notifyReactionMilestone, notifyMention.

capabilities.name: Push Notification Server Infrastructure
capabilities.currentBehavior: Routes are non-DB console logging stubs. register-token explicitly logs 'Non-DB invariant: Do NOT insert into device_tokens table'. send only logs to console.
capabilities.knownDefects: Zero push notifications are delivered to real devices from backend; push tokens are never stored in PostgreSQL push_tokens table.
capabilities.whatMustBeBuiltLater: Wire register-token to push_tokens table; integrate Firebase Cloud Messaging (FCM) / Apple APNs dispatch service.

capabilities.name: Deep Linking from Notifications
capabilities.currentBehavior: Triggers attach route string (e.g. '/(tabs)/dashboard'). expo-router handles deep linking if launched from notification.
capabilities.knownDefects: No route handling for deep-linking to a specific post, comment, or user profile (e.g. /post/:id, /user/:id).
capabilities.whatMustBeBuiltLater: Canonical URL scheme and universal link routing for /post/:id, /status/:id, /user/:handle.

capabilities.name: Unread Counters & Badge Sync
capabilities.currentBehavior: Local store tracks unreadCount and displays badge on Profile screen bell icon. DB has index idx_notification_log_unread.
capabilities.knownDefects: Local unread count does not sync with server notification_log read status; badge count resets or drifts across devices.
capabilities.reusableComponents: Bell icon with badge in profile.tsx header.
capabilities.whatMustBeBuiltLater: Server unread count endpoint and bidirectional sync.

capabilities.name: Notification Digest Infrastructure
capabilities.currentBehavior: No daily/weekly email or push digest service exists.
capabilities.knownDefects: Inactive users receive no re-engagement summaries.
capabilities.whatMustBeBuiltLater: Scheduled worker aggregating top 3 posts in citizen's Kshetra for a weekly digest.

capabilities.name: Community Challenges & Civic Quests
capabilities.currentBehavior: Database tables support challenges with categories, points, target counts, and participant progress. DataService has fetchChallenges.
capabilities.knownDefects: W011-DEF-05: joinChallenge and completeModule in stores/aspirant.ts mutate local MMKV only and never call backend persistence.
capabilities.reusableComponents: community_challenges table schema; fetchChallenges in DataService.
capabilities.whatMustBeBuiltLater: Wire challenge participation and completion to database; render challenges in community feed.

capabilities.name: Community Groups / Local Forums
capabilities.currentBehavior: No dedicated groups, clubs, or neighborhood forum entities exist in schema or app. Discourse is purely broadcast/feed.
capabilities.knownDefects: Citizens cannot form issue-specific or locality-specific civic working groups.
capabilities.whatMustBeBuiltLater: community_groups (id, name, slug, constituency_id, description, member_count) and group_memberships.

capabilities.name: Content Moderation & Trust & Safety
capabilities.currentBehavior: Fail-closed OpenAI moderation check (W009-B3) blocking hate speech, harassment, and violence. Moderation actions logged to moderation_actions table.
capabilities.knownDefects: W011-DEF-12 & W011-DEF-13: Fastify moderation routes return synthetic IDs for verify-request and block/unblock when Supabase is disconnected.
capabilities.reusableComponents: checkContentModeration helper in DataService; Fastify moderation controller.
capabilities.whatMustBeBuiltLater: Fix disconnected DB fallbacks (W011-B1); add image moderation for avatars and status media.

capabilities.name: Citizen Reporting & Grievance Flagging
capabilities.currentBehavior: Comprehensive reporting sheet allowing citizens to report posts, comments, or users with categorized reasons (spam, harassment, misinformation, hate_speech, violence, impersonation, other).
capabilities.apiPath: Direct Supabase client (or Fastify apiClient for civic issues)
capabilities.rlsStatus: Users read own reports; authors cannot see who reported them.
capabilities.knownDefects: None
capabilities.whatMustBeBuiltLater: Moderator triage dashboard for community volunteer reviewers.

capabilities.name: Administrative Hierarchy Graph
capabilities.functionOrRoute: states, constituencies, mandals, gram_panchayats, polling_booths, urban_local_bodies, ulb_wards
capabilities.currentBehavior: Robust spatial and administrative schema modeling India's complex hierarchy with PostGIS boundaries, centroids, Census 2011 populations, and M:N mandal↔constituency mapping.
capabilities.rlsStatus: FORCE RLS active. Public read policies.
capabilities.knownDefects: Spatial boundaries for sub-constituency levels are sparsely populated with real geometry in staging seed data.
capabilities.reusableComponents: Complete database table schemas, PostGIS indexes, and foreign keys.
capabilities.whatMustBeBuiltLater: Bulk boundary geoJSON ingestion for assembly and ward delimitation boundaries.

capabilities.name: My Kshetra Implementation (Mobile)
capabilities.currentBehavior: Stores home AC in MMKV; sets default state filter; used to filter civic issues and local posts.
capabilities.notificationDependency: Used to filter localized push triggers.
capabilities.knownDefects: Not synchronized with user_profiles.constituency_id in database.
capabilities.whatMustBeBuiltLater: Sync home constituency with user_profiles; support multi-tier home (e.g. Ward 42 + Sanathnagar AC + Hyderabad District).

capabilities.name: Geographic Feed Filtering
capabilities.currentBehavior: Filters posts by state_code and constituency_id using composite index idx_posts_scope. Mobile feed has 3 scope toggles: National, State, Constituency.
capabilities.knownDefects: None
capabilities.reusableComponents: Scope toggle UI in feed header; idx_posts_scope database index.
capabilities.whatMustBeBuiltLater: Extend scope filter to support Mandal, Ward, and Polling Booth levels.

capabilities.name: Kshetra Social Pages (Constituency Entity Pages)
capabilities.currentBehavior: Constituency screen shows electoral analytics, past election results, candidate affidavits, and demographic data. It has NO social feed, NO community discussion tab, and NO 'Follow Kshetra' action.
capabilities.knownDefects: Constituency is treated as a static dataset rather than a living social and civic community.
capabilities.reusableComponents: Constituency banner and representative card in ConstituencyDetailScreen.
capabilities.whatMustBeBuiltLater: Transform constituency view into a hybrid Social Page: Tab 1 (Civic Feed & Discussions), Tab 2 (Active Issues), Tab 3 (Electoral Data), Tab 4 (Representatives & Candidates).

capabilities.name: Supabase Storage Buckets
capabilities.currentBehavior: Zero storage buckets defined in SQL migrations or Supabase configuration. Neither 'avatars', 'posts', 'issues', nor 'statuses' exists.
capabilities.knownDefects: Mobile client cannot upload binary files to Supabase cloud storage.
capabilities.whatMustBeBuiltLater: Migration creating storage buckets: 'avatars' (public, 2MB limit), 'post-media' (public, 10MB limit), 'issue-evidence' (public, 10MB limit), 'statuses' (public, 15MB limit, auto-expire).

capabilities.name: Storage Upload Policies & Signed URLs
capabilities.currentBehavior: No storage.objects RLS policies exist in migrations. No signed URL generation endpoint exists on Fastify.
capabilities.knownDefects: Even if buckets were created manually in dashboard, unauthenticated uploads or unauthorized deletions would be possible without RLS.
capabilities.whatMustBeBuiltLater: storage.objects RLS policies: authenticated users can insert into their own folder (bucket/user_id/*), public read.

capabilities.name: Image & Video Processing Pipeline
capabilities.currentBehavior: No image resizing, thumbnail generation, video transcoding, or EXIF stripping.
capabilities.knownDefects: EXIF metadata (GPS coordinates, device info) not stripped before upload, presenting privacy risk.
capabilities.whatMustBeBuiltLater: Client-side image processing (strip EXIF, resize to max 1920x1080, convert to WebP); video thumbnail generation.

capabilities.name: Orphan Media Cleanup
capabilities.currentBehavior: No garbage collection mechanism for uploaded images whose associated post/status creation failed or was deleted.
capabilities.knownDefects: Storage costs will grow unbounded from abandoned uploads.
capabilities.whatMustBeBuiltLater: Background worker identifying unreferenced storage objects older than 24 hours and purging them.

futureConceptsMapping.gapAnalysis: Basic table user_profiles exists with display_name, bio, avatar_url, role. Missing: cover image, unique handle, social counters, privacy controls, tabbed social activity feed.
futureConceptsMapping.prerequisites: Migration adding columns to user_profiles; Fastify profile API; Profile 2.0 mobile screen.

futureConceptsMapping.gapAnalysis: avatar_url column exists in user_profiles and UserProfileCard renders it. Missing: Supabase Storage bucket 'avatars', upload pipeline from camera/gallery, image cropping.
futureConceptsMapping.prerequisites: Storage bucket provisioning; mobile avatar upload handler.

futureConceptsMapping.gapAnalysis: banner_url only exists on 'pages' table for political organizations. Citizen user_profiles table has no banner/cover column.
futureConceptsMapping.prerequisites: Migration adding cover_image_url to user_profiles; banner upload component; responsive header layout.

futureConceptsMapping.gapAnalysis: user_profiles.bio exists with <= 300 char constraint. Mobile edit-profile screen allows updating it and persists via updateMyProfile.
futureConceptsMapping.prerequisites: Add content moderation check before saving bio.

futureConceptsMapping.gapAnalysis: constituency_id exists on user_profiles, and myConstituency store holds home constituency in MMKV. Missing: Verified Resident badge, voter status, ward-level micro-identity.
futureConceptsMapping.prerequisites: Synchronize myConstituency store with user_profiles; civic residency verification workflow.

futureConceptsMapping.gapAnalysis: Zero implementation. No database table, no TTL expiry, no mobile UI.
futureConceptsMapping.prerequisites: Migration creating user_statuses; pg_cron cleanup job; Status reel UI in feed header.

futureConceptsMapping.gapAnalysis: No media capture or upload pipeline for ephemeral stories.
futureConceptsMapping.prerequisites: Supabase Storage bucket 'statuses'; camera capture with text overlay; media compression.

futureConceptsMapping.gapAnalysis: No fullscreen viewer modal with animated progress bars, touch navigation, or reply action.
futureConceptsMapping.prerequisites: StatusViewerModal component using react-native-reanimated; touch gesture handlers.

futureConceptsMapping.gapAnalysis: user_follows database table exists with RLS. Follow/unfollow functions work in DataService. Missing: follower/following count columns on user_profiles, follower/following list screens, follow notifications.
futureConceptsMapping.prerequisites: Add follower_count/following_count triggers to user_profiles; create Connections screen.

futureConceptsMapping.gapAnalysis: DataService has fetchVerifiedPoliticians and fetchPublicAspirants. Missing: Citizen discovery, 'Who to follow in your Kshetra', contact book sync, search by handle.
futureConceptsMapping.prerequisites: Fastify discovery endpoint; 'Discover People' carousel in feed and search tab.

futureConceptsMapping.gapAnalysis: stateDataAdapter.ts and administrative hierarchy migrations (022, 023) provide full search and traversal across states, constituencies, mandals, and wards.
futureConceptsMapping.prerequisites: Add social engagement metrics (active posts count, top issues count) to geography search cards.

futureConceptsMapping.gapAnalysis: Database tables (polls, poll_options, poll_votes) exist with vote uniqueness constraint. However, ComposeSheet.tsx generates local synthetic IDs and never saves polls to Supabase.
futureConceptsMapping.prerequisites: Fix W011-DEF-01: Update composePost to insert poll + options transactionally in database.

futureConceptsMapping.gapAnalysis: posts.type supports 'question', and PostCard renders question icon/badge. Missing: Best-answer selection, representative tagging, status tracking ('Answered by MLA').
futureConceptsMapping.prerequisites: Add accepted_comment_id column to posts; question resolution badge.

futureConceptsMapping.gapAnalysis: UserProfileScreen (apps/mobile/app/user/[userId].tsx) renders author's posts. Missing: Tabbed navigation for Posts, Replies/Comments, Upvotes, Media, and Questions.
futureConceptsMapping.prerequisites: Fetch functions for user comments and upvotes; tabbed pager component.

futureConceptsMapping.gapAnalysis: No dynamic image generator or QR code card for sharing citizen or candidate profiles to WhatsApp/Instagram.
futureConceptsMapping.prerequisites: react-native-view-shot or backend OpenGraph image generator (/api/v1/og/profile/:handle).

futureConceptsMapping.gapAnalysis: Constituency screens (app/constituency/[id].tsx) only show historical election data and affidavits. No social feed, no community chat, no 'Follow Kshetra' button.
futureConceptsMapping.prerequisites: Add localized social feed tab to constituency screen; wire Follow Constituency to user_favourites table.

futureConceptsMapping.gapAnalysis: notification_log and preferences tables exist in DB, but trigger_type CHECK constraint lacks 'new_follower', API routes are non-DB stubs, and push delivery is disconnected.
futureConceptsMapping.prerequisites: Expand notification trigger types in schema; connect register-token to push_tokens table; integrate push delivery.
